card.name: Re-suspending particles in a liquid
card.fires_on: Parts of words like re, re-s, res or slurry just before the word suspend or suspension, in mixing and preparation instructions. It fires where the next word is likely to be suspend or suspension.

modes.label: Re-suspend
modes.description: The start of re-suspend, after a verb like shake, stir or invert, meaning to disperse settled particles.
modes.example: stir the suspension with the same spoon to<< re>>-suspend any particles before administration.

modes.label: Making a slurry or suspension
modes.description: Words in preparation steps that lead into suspension, such as slurry, a, or homogenous.
modes.example: Gently swirl the vial until a hom<<ogenous>> suspension is obtained.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write suspend, suspension or susp next.
card.plain: It fires in mixing instructions when the next word is likely suspend or suspension.
